name: Bellisio Foods
old_description: Our passion is food. Bellisio Foods, Inc. is a fast growing company with a long history of providing quality, innovative food that meets and exceeds consumers’ needs. Bellisio Foods makes a strong investment in people who are committed to building dynamic and respected brands. We strive for excellence in all we do!
about:
Bellisio Foods, Inc. operates from Jackson, Ohio, where it produces frozen meals for retail brands and contract-manufacturing partners. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its history traces back to early quality practices attributed to an individual named Jeno, who conducted taste tests that shaped its quality-assurance culture.

The company runs full-scale production facilities that handle component processing, manufacturing, cooling, freezing, warehousing, and storage, turning out more than two million meals each day. A dedicated culinary center supports product development, where food scientists and chefs create new recipes and custom formulations for both Bellisio's own brands and partner labels. Services span research and development, commercialization support, and contract manufacturing.

Bellisio serves the frozen-food sector, supplying retail grocery brands, foodservice channels, and private-label partners. Its customer base includes companies seeking custom frozen-meal formulations and large-scale production capacity, though specific client names are not public.

Bellisio emphasizes innovation and consistent quality, positioning its culinary center and integrated production-to-warehousing flow as key differentiators. The company states it is dedicated to being an expert in the commercialization and production of the highest-quality frozen meals possible, with a quality-assurance program that began with sensory evaluation and continues through every production step.
